title: Lesson 18 · He often does this!
titleZh: 第18课 他经常干这种事！

examples.en: After I had had lunch at a village pub, I looked for my bag.
examples.zh: 我在一家乡村小酒店吃过午饭后，就找我的提包。

sentences.en: After I had had lunch at a village pub, I looked for my bag.
sentences.zh: 我在一家乡村小酒店吃过午饭后，就找我的提包。

sentences.en: I had left it on a chair beside the door and now it wasn't there!
sentences.zh: 我曾把它放在门边的一把椅子上，可这会儿不见了！

sentences.en: As I was looking for it, the landlord came in.
sentences.zh: 当我正在寻找它时，酒店老板走了进来。

sentences.en: The landlord smiled and immediately went out.
sentences.zh: 老板笑了笑，马上走了出去。

article.en: After I had had lunch at a village pub, I looked for my bag.
article.zh: 我在一家乡村小酒店吃过午饭后，就找我的提包。

article.en: I had left it on a chair beside the door and now it wasn't there!
article.zh: 我曾把它放在门边的一把椅子上，可这会儿不见了！

article.en: As I was looking for it, the landlord came in.
article.zh: 当我正在寻找它时，酒店老板走了进来。

article.en: 'Did you have a good meal?' he asked.
'Yes, thank you,' I answered, 'but I can't pay the bill. I haven't got my bag.'
article.zh: ‘很好，谢谢，’我回答，‘但我付不了账，我的提包没有了。’

article.en: The landlord smiled and immediately went out.
article.zh: 老板笑了笑，马上走了出去。

article.en: In a few minutes he returned with my bag and gave it back to me.
article.zh: 一会儿工夫他拿着我的提包回来了，把它还给了我。

article.en: 'My dog had taken it into the garden. He often does this!'
article.zh: ‘我的狗把它叼到花园里去了，它经常干这种事！’
